newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP NAMES MINERAL UNIT EXECUTIVE FILL-INS.
newsitem.headline: BHP NAMES MINERAL UNIT EXECUTIVE FILL-INS.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd on Thursday named temporary replacements for its minerals division following the resignations of division chief Dick Carter on Wednesday and iron ore head Geoff Wedlock earlier on Wednesday.

The company said Lance Coburn, group general manager and senior vice president of finance for BHP Minerals, would be acting executive general manager while Derek Miller, general manager railways and ports at Port Hedland, would act as group general manager for BHP Iron Ore.
BHP said the appointments were effective from today.

BHP also said Ian McMaster, the group general manager and senior vice president hot briquetted iron (HBI), was now completely responsibile for the HBI projects in Pilbara in Western Australia and in Venezuela, reporting to Coburn.
